    <script type="text/javascript">

        $(function () {

            $('[data-pesquisa]').keypress(function (e) {

                var tecla = (e.keyCode ? e.keyCode : e.which);

                if (tecla == 13) {
                    return false;
                }

            });

        });

        function LimparCampos() {
            $('[data-pesquisa]').each(function () {
                switch (this.type) {
                    case "file":
                    case "password":
                    case "text":
                    case "textarea":
                        $(this).val("");
                        break;
                    case "checkbox":
                    case "radio":
                        this.checked = false;
                }

                $(this).children("option:selected").removeAttr("selected").end()
                    .children("option:first").attr("selected", "selected");
            });
        }
    </script>
